system.description:
| Flesh Crafting – Manic / [Physical], [Mental] / A creature can only become Manic if they are of the Jugo Clan and have reached the maximum amount of Nature Energy, they can maintain. While Manic, you gain the following penalty and benefits: / Penalty / While Manic, you suffer the effects of the Berserk condition as if you yourself are your own compeller. / Benefits / A Manic creature gains a +1 bonus to their critical threat range. This increases to +2, if attacking a creature that dealt damage to you since the end of your last turn. / A Manic creature that scores a critical hit, adds 2d12 force damage to the result. This increases by 1d12 at 7th and 15th levels. / A Manic creature can make one additional weapon or Unarmed attack when they take the Attack Action. / A Manic creatures speed increases by +10 feet. They gain an additional +10 speed when moving towards a creature that dealt damage to you since the end of your last turn. / A Manic creature spends 4 feet of movement for every 1 feet they spend moving away from a valid hostile creature while not also moving towards another valid hostile creature. / This condition ends when you would reach 0 Nature Energy. |

7th Level Clan Feature

Your attunement to Nature Energy extends beyond your own body and into your surroundings while not in combat, using it to communicate with beasts of the land and even the land itself. You gain the Animal Speak language.

Animal Speak. you can understand and speak to all land-based animals.

Also, by spending 10 minutes focusing, you attune to your surroundings and for the next hour, you can extract information from natural terrain and animals you communicate with. You gain 2 ranks of Mastery to all Charisma checks made against them for the duration.

Additionally, for the duration, you can learn the following about an area you can see:

You learn the movement patterns of creatures that have passed through within the last 24 hours, learning their size, the number of them and their direction.

If Chakra has be used in your general area within the last 24 hours and the approximate location it was used.

The location of water sources, natural shelter such as caves or underbrush’s.

If a creature of your size or larger is hiding within 120 feet of you. This does not reveal their location, just their presence.

Once you attune yourself, you cannot do so again until you complete a short rest.
